mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and can cause acute kidney injury; ganciclovir may increase zoledronic acid accumulation by impairing renal clearance, elevating risk of osteonecrosis of the jaw and renal toxicity.
action: Monitor serum creatinine and creatinine clearance closely; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antivirals if possible; space dosing appropriately based on renal function.
